papers.title: Ion Pathways Optimized via Interlayer Channels in Bimetallic Hydroxides Enable Ultra‐Stable Solid‐State Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Solid polymer electrolytes (SPEs) from electrospinning offer robust mechanical frameworks but often require complex post‐treatments and suffer from low room‐temperature ionic conductivity and sluggish Li + transport, hindering the development of solid‐state batteries. Here, we propose a surface‐grown protective fiber strategy: growing CoMn‐layered double hydroxide (LDH) nanosheets on polyacrylonitrile (PAN) nanofibers to anchor residual propylene carbonate (PC) molecules, forming a composite SPE (LDH@PAN SPE) with interfacial stabilization. Abundant LDH hydroxyl groups immobilize PC via hydrogen bonding, while metal sites electrostatically interact with the lithium salt anions (TFSI − ), promoting Li salt dissociation and optimizing [Li(PC) x ] + solvation. Additionally, hydrogen bonding between PAN cyano‐groups and LDH creates continuous radial Li + pathways. The LDH@PAN SPE achieves high ionic conductivity (1.36 mS cm −1 ), Li + transference number (0.80 at 20°C), and a 4.9 V window. Li||Li symmetric cells cycle for 1600 h at 0.2 mA cm −2 with a critical current density of 1.8 mA cm −2 . LiFePO 4 ||Li full cells deliver excellent rate capability (110.2 mAh g −1 at 5 C) and long‐term cycling (81.3% retention after 1100 cycles at 1 C) at room temperature, alongside flexibility and flame retardancy. This work offers a new interfacial engineering and ion‐transport strategy for high‐performance solid‐state lithium metal batteries.
papers.summary_ko: CoMn 층상이중수산화물(LDH) 나노시트를 PAN 나노섬유 표면에 성장시켜 잔류 프로필렌카보네이트를 고정하고 Li+ 전달 경로를 형성한 복합 고체 고분자 전해질(LDH@PAN SPE)을 제안한다. 이 전해질은 1.36 mS/cm의 이온전도도와 0.80의 Li+ 이동수, 4.9V의 전기화학적 안정성 창을 달성했다. Li||Li 대칭셀은 1600시간 이상 안정적으로 구동되었고, LiFePO4||Li 완전셀은 1100회 사이클 후 81.3%의 용량 유지율을 보였다.

papers.title: Additive-assisted quasi-dry process enabling freestanding sulfide electrolyte films for all-solid-state batteries
papers.abstract_en: Sulfide solid-state electrolyte films that combine thinness, high ionic conductivity and large-area feasibility are needed to improve energy density and enable industrial-scale production of all-solid-state batteries. However, workable processing methods to integrate these critical features remain technically challenging. Herein, we demonstrate a quasi-dry process utilizing an organic additive (i.e., α-pinene), through which the fabricated sulfide electrolyte films successfully integrate all the aforementioned merits. α-Pinene is chemically compatible with Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5, improves film flexibility via stress dissipation, enhances ionic conductivity by promoting a more even distribution of the polytetrafluoroethylene binder, and facilitates film densification through lubrication. The resultant films with enhanced densification (porosity reduced from 12.24% to 7.78%) retain over 85% ionic conductivity of the pristine powder, exhibit an ionic conductivity of 4.79 mS/cm at 25 °C, with a thickness of 28 μm and lateral dimensions of 30 × 10 cm2. The Li4Ti5O12 | Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 | LiNbO3@LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2 full cells present a capacity retention of 93% after 500 cycles at 1 C under 2 MPa. At the stack level, a 50 mAh pouch cell retains 83% capacity after 1000 cycles at 0.5 C under 2 MPa. This work proposes an additive-assisted quasi-dry process, paving a pathway for material-process optimization toward potentially scalable fabrication of all-solid-state batteries. Thin sulfide electrolyte film could raise energy density of solid state battery, but producing thin, highly conductive film remains difficult. Here, authors develop an α-pinene assisted quasi-dry process to improve film quality and demonstrate a pouch cell retaining 83% capacity after 1000 cycles.
papers.summary_ko: α-피넨 첨가제를 활용한 준건식 공정으로 얇고 대면적인 황화물 고체전해질 필름(Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5)을 제작하는 방법을 제시한다. 이 공정은 기공률을 12.24%에서 7.78%로 낮추고 25°C에서 4.79 mS/cm의 이온전도도를 달성했다. 관련 완전셀은 500회 사이클 후 93%의 용량 유지율을 보였으며, 50mAh 파우치셀은 1000회 사이클 후 83%를 유지했다.

papers.title: Robust SEI and Uniform Na Deposition Enabled by Sodiophilic Interface for Durable Anode‐Free Sodium Metal Batteries Across Ambient and Subzero Conditions
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Anode‐free sodium metal batteries (AFSMBs) are regarded as promising next‐generation energy storage device because of their exceptionally high energy density and low cost. However, their practical application is still hindered by uncontrolled sodium dendrites growth and unstable solid electrolyte interface (SEI) formation. To address these challenges, a sodiophilic Ag interface was in situ constructed on the copper foil current collector to regulate the uniform Na deposition and promote a stable SEI formation. Combined theoretical calculations and experimental analysis revealed that the Ag interface enables uniform Na deposition by enhancing sodiophilicity and homogenizing the electric field, while also promoting the decomposition of NaPF 6 to form a robust and thin SEI. Consequently, the Ag─Cu||Na asymmetric cells exhibited stable cycling for over 1100 cycles with a high Coulombic efficiency of 99.87% at 1 mA cm −2 . Moreover, AFSMBs paired with Na 3 V 2 (PO 4 ) 3 cathode delivered a capacity retention of 70% after 500 cycles at 2C. Furthermore, the AFSMBs also maintained stable cycling over 150 cycles at −20°C under 0.05C. These results demonstrate the significant potential of introducing a sodiophilic interfacial layer to regulate uniform sodium deposition and promote stable SEI formation, thereby enabling high‐performance anode‐free sodium metal batteries across ambient and subzero conditions.
papers.summary_ko: 무음극 소듐금속전지(AFSMB)의 덴드라이트 및 불안정한 SEI 문제를 해결하기 위해 구리 집전체에 소듐친화적인 Ag 계면을 형성하는 전략을 제안한다. Ag 계면은 균일한 전기장 분포와 소듐친화성을 통해 균일한 Na 증착을 유도하고 얇고 견고한 SEI 형성을 촉진한다. Ag-Cu||Na 비대칭셀은 1100회 이상 사이클에서 99.87%의 쿨롱효율을 보였고, 완전셀은 500회 사이클 후 70%의 용량을 유지하며 -20°C에서도 150회 이상 안정적으로 구동되었다.

papers.title: Internal Electric Field‐Guided, Low‐Adsorption Ferroelectric Anode Protective Layers for Sustainable Suppression of Polysulfide Side Reactions in Lithium–Sulfur Batteries
papers.abstract_en: ABSTRACT Lithium–sulfur batteries (LSBs) offer energy densities beyond lithium‐ion batteries, yet parasitic reactions between soluble polysulfides and lithium metal cause active‐sulfur loss and porous Li, undermining cycle life. To address this problem, an anode protective layer is needed, but interactions between protective layers and polysulfides remain insufficiently understood. In this work, representative anionic and ceramic protective layers are employed as model systems to establish how strong polysulfide adsorption and persistent sulfur‐species retention affect protective‐layer functionality. Building on these findings, a positively polarized ferroelectric β‐pvdf layer incorporating fluorinated boron nitride nanosheets (PPFBN) is introduced. Corona poling aligns polarization to establish an internal field, while insulating nanosheets suppress free‐charge relaxation, thereby sustaining the field. The field promotes Li + transport to the anode and impedes the approach of polysulfide anions, while intrinsically low polysulfide affinity limits long‐term degradation of layer functionality. With PPFBN, Li/Li symmetric cells cycle stably for >1000 h in polysulfide‐containing electrolytes at 2 mA cm − 2 and 2 mAh cm − 2 . Full cells retain 80.4% capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C; under lean‐electrolyte conditions, cycle life extends by more than 150 cycles relative to bare Li. This study establishes a ferroelectric‐field, low‐polysulfide‐affinity design principle for durable anode protection in LSBs.
papers.summary_ko: 리튬-황전지(LSB)에서 폴리설파이드와 리튬 금속의 부반응을 억제하기 위해 내부 전기장을 활용한 강유전체 β-PVDF 보호층(PPFBN)을 제안한다. 코로나 폴링으로 분극을 정렬하고 절연성 나노시트로 전하 이완을 억제해 내부 전기장을 유지함으로써 Li+ 이동은 촉진하고 폴리설파이드 음이온의 접근은 차단한다. PPFBN을 적용한 Li/Li 대칭셀은 폴리설파이드 함유 전해질에서 1000시간 이상 안정적으로 구동되었고, 완전셀은 500회 사이클 후 80.4%의 용량을 유지했다.
